title: Permitted Obstructions
previewText: In all Commercial Districts, the provisions of Section 33-42 (Permitted Obstructions) shall apply to any building or other structure. In addition, a dormer shall be allowed as a permitted obstruction pursuant to paragraph (b) of Section 23-413 (Permitted obstructions in certain districts).
